company.name: Arda Therapeutics
company.shortDescription: Arda is taking aim at chronic diseases and aging by eliminating the pathogenic cells that drive these conditions.
company.description:
Arda Therapeutics is a biotechnology company taking aim at chronic diseases and aging by eliminating the pathogenic cells that drive these conditions. Their approach starts by using single-cell data to identify pathogenic cells and specific markers to target them. They then design therapies to eliminate these - and only these - cells.

Arda was founded in 2021 in the San Francisco Bay Area, CA.

productsAndServices.description: Therapies designed to selectively eliminate pathogenic cells that drive chronic and immunological diseases by targeting specific cell-surface markers identified through single-cell data analysis.
productsAndServices.name: Targeted Cell Depletion Therapies
